deployed_changes: CLI tool and agent guide assets, plus their digest/version bindings
upgrade_policy: Use current tools. Old invitation downloads can have different bytes after an update; the personal AI must stop on an expected-digest mismatch and obtain a fresh invitation, never substitute the response digest or disable TLS verification. Existing approved pairings are not revoked by this asset deployment.
limits: This is public asset delivery verification, not a new physical-device or personal-AI acceptance run.
Download verification is performed by the personal AI; the server does not enforce the old invitation digest on a public download request.
The recommended Android APK remains code39. Candidate code49 installation and its separate acceptance do not follow from this relay deployment.
The first readback script misread the CLI request return type; the script was corrected without redeploying or changing the product.
privacy: Aggregate checks and public artifact digests only; no credentials, tickets, raw user content or private deployment paths.
